text_en: To the leader: on Lilies, a Covenant. Of Asaph. A Psalm.
text_cn: 阿撒夫的诗歌，交与乐官。调寄"见证的百合"。

text_en: Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock! You who are enthroned upon the cherubim, shine forth
text_cn: 以色列的牧养者，恳求你留心细听， 你率领若瑟的子孙有如率领羊群。 坐于革鲁宾之上者，求你大显光荣。

text_en: before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh. Stir up your might, and come to save us!
text_cn: 于厄弗辣因、本雅明和默纳协之中； 求你发显你的威能， 快来作我们的救星！

text_en: Restore us, O God; let your face shine, that we may be saved.
text_cn: 天主，求你使我们能以复兴， 显示你的慈颜，好拯救我们。

text_en: O Lord God of hosts, how long will you be angry with your people’s prayers?
text_cn: 万军的天主，何时消除 向你祈祷的百姓发怒？

text_en: You have fed them with the bread of tears, and given them tears to drink in full measure.
text_cn: 你给他们吃的是含泪的食物， 你用汪汪泪水，作他们的饮料。

text_en: You make us the scorn of our neighbors; our enemies laugh among themselves.
text_cn: 你使我们四邻因我们而争吵， 你让我们的仇人向我们嘲笑。

text_en: Restore us, O God of hosts; let your face shine, that we may be saved.
text_cn: 万军的天主，求你复兴我们， 显示你的慈颜，好拯救我们。

text_en: You brought a vine out of Egypt; you drove out the nations and planted it.
text_cn: 你从埃及移来一棵葡萄树， 你把异民赶走，而种植这树。

text_en: You cleared the ground for it; it took deep root and filled the land.
text_cn: 给这树准备了肥沃土质， 这树深深扎根，满布大地。

text_en: The mountains were covered with its shade, the mighty cedars with its branches;
text_cn: 它的荫影遮蔽着群山峻岭， 它的枝干与苍天松柏相等；

text_en: it sent out its branches to the sea, and its shoots to the River.
text_cn: 它的枝蔓伸展到海涯、 它的根苗绵延到河坝。

text_en: Why then have you broken down its walls, so that all who pass along the way pluck its fruit?
text_cn: 你为何折毁了它的篱笆， 任凭过路的人去砍伐，

text_en: The boar from the forest ravages it, and all that move in the field feed on it.
text_cn: 使森林的野猪去践踏， 使田间的野兽去吃它？

text_en: Turn again, O God of hosts; look down from heaven, and see; have regard for this vine,
text_cn: 万军的天主，求你领我们回去， 求你从高天之上垂视而怜恤！

text_en: the stock that your right hand planted.
text_cn: 求你常看顾这葡萄树， 和你右手种植的园圃， 保护你所培养的小树。

text_en: They have burned it with fire, they have cut it down; may they perish at the rebuke of your countenance.
text_cn: 愿那放火焚烧它，砍伐它的人， 因懔于你怒容的威吓而沉沦。

text_en: But let your hand be upon the one at your right hand, the one whom you made strong for yourself.
text_cn: 愿你右手扶持你右边的人。 并扶助为你所坚固的子民！

text_en: Then we will never turn back from you; give us life, and we will call on your name.
text_cn: 从此，我们再不愿意离开你， 赐我们生存，为能传扬你名。

text_en: Restore us, O Lord God of hosts; let your face shine, that we may be saved.
text_cn: 上主万军的天主，求你复兴我们， 显示你的慈颜，好拯救我们！
